pr.body:
Closes #184. Change set CS-001 on the DPI-H public comment log.

## What to expect in this review

<!-- review-brief -->
- **Overall:** editorial and clarity revisions to the executive summary and glossary, with glossary terms linked at first use in every chapter, owned by the core architects, in smart-ra#185.
- **No. [136](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/public-comments/folio/dpi-h-ra/#PC-0137):** Accepted. DPI-F defined at first use in the executive summary, with a glossary entry; glossary terms linked at first use in every chapter.
- **No. [326](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/public-comments/folio/dpi-h-ra/#PC-0327):** Accepted. The opening paragraph says "multiple levels and places of care".
- **No. [327](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/public-comments/folio/dpi-h-ra/#PC-0328):** Accepted. TOGAF and ArchiMate glossed at first use in the executive summary, with a glossary entry each, and linked to it.
- **No. [126](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/public-comments/folio/dpi-h-ra/#PC-0127):** Not accepted. Already addressed: the executive summary already names multiple health programmes, multiple diseases and multiple levels of care.
- **No. [137](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/public-comments/folio/dpi-h-ra/#PC-0138):** Not accepted. Already a complete phrase.
- **Nos. [127](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/public-comments/folio/dpi-h-ra/#PC-0128), [128](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/public-comments/folio/dpi-h-ra/#PC-0129), [129](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/public-comments/folio/dpi-h-ra/#PC-0130), [130](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/public-comments/folio/dpi-h-ra/#PC-0131), [131](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/public-comments/folio/dpi-h-ra/#PC-0132), [134](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/public-comments/folio/dpi-h-ra/#PC-0135), [135](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/public-comments/folio/dpi-h-ra/#PC-0136), [138](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/public-comments/folio/dpi-h-ra/#PC-0139) and [139](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-ra/en/folio-assistant-core/public-comments/folio/dpi-h-ra/#PC-0140):** Not accepted. Already reflected or not needed.
- **Where to look:** the executive summary (DPI-F, TOGAF, ArchiMate, places of care), the glossary chapter, and the glossary links at first use in each chapter
<!-- /review-brief -->
